IncidentDef.label: Thalmor justiciars
IncidentDef.letterText:
A pair of Thalmor justiciars has come to the colony with a writ. The White-Gold Concordat forbids the worship of Talos, and they have heard that {PAWN_nameDef} still keeps the old faith.

They want {PAWN_objective} handed over for questioning. Few people the justiciars take for questioning are seen again.

If you refuse, {FACTION_name} will count the colony as an enemy and send soldiers to take {PAWN_objective} by force.

li.handOverText: The justiciars put {PAWN_nameDef} in irons and lead {PAWN_objective} away toward the nearest Thalmor embassy. {FACTION_name} is pleased with your cooperation.
li.refuseText: The justiciars leave without {PAWN_nameDef}, and they leave angry. {FACTION_name} now counts the colony among the enemies of the Dominion, and its soldiers are already on the road.
